Responda de forma curta e direta. Vá ao: Answer briefly and directly. Get to the point, with no introduction and no summary at the end. Use lists only when they really help.
Explique como para alguém que está apren: Explain as you would to someone who is learning: define technical terms the first time, give a concrete example and say why each step matters.
Escreva em tom profissional e formal, co: Write in a professional, formal tone, with complete sentences and clear organization, suitable for a work email or document.
